liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (3 reviews): Half-Step into I Know You Rider felt like a novelty, more typical of Phil & Friends or the Other Dead; Reviewer recommends playing the Half-Step into Rider loudly [30][38][39]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Stranger the best ever and praises its screaming, powerful ending [30]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Cassidy was one of the songs that stood out for this first-time attendee [31]
- **Comes A Time** (1 review): Comes A Time was one of the songs that stood out for this first-time attendee [31]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Reviewer loves the segue between Stagger Lee and Cassidy [31]
- **Touch of Grey** (1 review): Reviewer finds Touch Of Grey played too fast [39]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Truckin' coming out of Space really cool and rocking [39]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd85-11-10 t01 Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **gd85-11-10 t02 Touch Of Grey**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **gd85-11-10 t03 Hell In A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **gd85-11-10 t04 Sugaree**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **gd85-11-10 t05 Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **gd85-11-10 t06 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **gd85-11-10 t07 Stagger Lee**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]
- **gd85-11-10 t08 It's All Over Now**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [42]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-10.141082.sbd.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 146 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd85-11-10.oade.connor.7955.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 147 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this Oade recording captures the show's energy best [37]
- **gd85-11-10.aud-oade.dwonk.19212.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 146 min; rated 3.7/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer likes the big, rich sound of the Oade recordings of this show [32]
- **gd1985-11-10.151337.senn441.hunt.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 147 min [6]
- **gd1985-11-10.152046.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 141 min [17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer couldn't get in; people streaming out afterward called it a killer show, which the recording confirms [34]
- Reviewer was 15 and traveled 140 miles, the farthest yet to see the Dead [37]
- Reviewer says the Half-Step to Rider pairing is unusual for the Dead, resembling Phil & Friends or the Other Dead [30]
- Another Stranger, 3/23/87, also falls late in set one; it lacks this ending jam but has more energy [32]
- Reviewer considers New York audiences very demanding and the Dead's New York shows the pinnacle of touring [34]
- Reviewer disagrees that this is the best Stranger, saying it depends on what qualities you value [35]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-10.141082.sbd.miller.clugston.flac1644**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassette (dolby b decoded) > Dat; Transfer Info: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition 3.0 >… [1]
- **gd85-11-10.oade.connor.7955.sbeok.shnf**: source: Oade's Master Audience PCM > Schoeps CMC-441 mics > Oade M118> Sony PCM-F1 > DAT> CDREAC'ed/Shn'ed by Charlie Connor 3/2/02, with thanks to Scott Clugston and… [4]
- **gd85-11-10.aud-oade.dwonk.19212.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps CMC441 (FOB, 90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade modSONY PCM-F1 [5]
- **gd1985-11-10.151337.senn441.hunt.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Hunt and Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Rob Hunt and Ted Mattes' Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: An Oade Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies a 0:59 patch in Space [6]
- **gd1985-11-10.152046.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes (Floor, Section B, Row 1, Seat 9); Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [17]. Also: An Oade Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies a 0:12 patch in Space [17]
